# RichEditBox

Header: `winui/ui/text/RichEditBox.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/text/RichEditBox.hpp`.

An editable, formatted document that looks like a [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox).

The document is plain text (`\n` between paragraphs) with a character format per character. The user edits it as in a multi-line [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox), formats with Ctrl+B/I/U or the context menu, and undoes with Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y. The app reads and writes it as [text()](#text), [spans()](#spans) or RTF, and formats the selection with [set_selection_format()](#set_selection_format). Only the user's changes raise [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed), never changes made from code. In a spec tree it is built by [`ui::RichEditBox`](#uiricheditbox).

Example: 
```cpp
std::string draft; // the saved document, as RTF
auto  panel  = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto* bold   = panel->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Bold"));
auto* editor = panel->add(std::make_unique<ui::RichEditBoxControl>());
editor->set_header("Notes");
editor->set_placeholder_text("Type here");
editor->set_height(240.0f);
editor->load_rtf(R"({\rtf1\ansi Hello, {\b world}!\par})");
bold->on_click([editor] { editor->toggle_bold(); });
editor->on_text_changed([editor, &draft] { draft = editor->save_rtf(); });
window.set_content(std::move(panel));
```

## `ui::RichEditBox`

Editable rich text: character formatting, undo, RTF in and out. Builds a [ui::RichEditBoxControl](#uiricheditboxcontrol).

Formatting is applied through the built control (via [`.control`](#uiricheditbox-control)); the spec only sets up the document and its editing rules.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Control<ui::RichEditBox> editor;
bool                dirty  = false;

window.set_content(ui::RichEditBox{
    .header           = "Notes",
    .placeholder_text = "Write here",
    .height           = 200,
    .on_text_changed  = [&] { dirty = true; },
    .control          = editor,
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::RichEditBox{
    .header, .description, .error, .placeholder_text, .text, .max_length, .spell_check,
    .read_only, .accepts_return, .character_casing, .disabled_formatting_shortcuts, .wrapping,
    .text_alignment, .font_family, .font_size, .foreground, .selection_highlight_color, .style,
    .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height,
    .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility,
    .on_text_changed, .on_selection_changed, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited,
    .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control
}
```

### struct CharacterFormat

A character format to apply to a range, or read back from one. Applying it sets every field that is set and leaves every unset one alone. When reading, a field is unset where the range mixes values.

[`control_default`](#struct-characterformat) lists the color, family and size fields that follow the control's own value. For the background, that means no highlight. When applied, those fields go back to the control's value before the set fields are applied. When read, it lists the fields the whole range leaves to the control.

Example: 
```cpp
auto editor = std::make_unique<ui::RichEditBoxControl>("Hello, world!");
editor->select(0, 5);
editor->set_selection_format({.italic = true, .font_size = 20.0f}); // bold etc. untouched
if (editor->selection_format().bold == true) { /* ... */ }          // the whole range is bold
editor->set_selection_format({.control_default = ui::RichTextFormatField::Foreground});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bold` | `std::optional<bool>` |  | Bold on/off; unset leaves it, or reads as mixed. |
| `italic` | `std::optional<bool>` |  | Italic on/off. |
| `underline` | `std::optional<bool>` |  | Underline on/off. |
| `strikethrough` | `std::optional<bool>` |  | Strikethrough on/off. |
| `foreground` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | [Text](text.md#uitext) color. |
| `background` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | Highlight color. |
| `font_family` | `std::optional<std::string>` |  | Font family. |
| `font_size` | `OptionalFloat` |  | Font size in DIPs. |
| `control_default` | `RichTextFormatField` | `RichTextFormatField::None` | The fields that follow the control's own value. |

## struct RichTextFormat

The character format one character of a [RichEditBox](#uiricheditbox) carries. An unset color, family or size follows the control's own (its [foreground()](#struct-richtextformat), [font_family()](#struct-richtextformat) and [font_size()](#struct-richtextformat)).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bold` | `bool` | `false` | Bold weight. |
| `italic` | `bool` | `false` | Italic style. |
| `underline` | `bool` | `false` | Underlined. |
| `strikethrough` | `bool` | `false` | Struck through. |
| `foreground` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | [Text](text.md#uitext) color; unset is the control's [foreground()](#struct-richtextformat). |
| `background` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | Highlight behind the text; unset paints none. |
| `font_family` | `std::optional<std::string>` |  | Font family; unset is the control's [font_family()](#struct-richtextformat). |
| `font_size` | `OptionalFloat` |  | Font size in DIPs; unset is the control's [font_size()](#struct-richtextformat). |

## struct RichTextSpan

A stretch of a [RichEditBox](#uiricheditbox)'s text in one format, as spans() hands out and set_spans() takes.

Example: 
```cpp
auto box = std::make_unique<ui::RichEditBoxControl>();
box->set_spans({
    {.text = "Hello, "},
    {.text = "world", .format = {.bold = true, .foreground = ui::Color::from_argb(0xFFC42B1C)}},
    {.text = "!\nA second paragraph."},
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `std::string` |  | The text (UTF-8); `\n` is a paragraph mark. |
| `format` | `RichTextFormat` |  | The format every character of [`text`](#struct-richtextspan) carries. |

## Enumerations

### RichTextFormatField

```cpp
enum class RichTextFormatField : std::uint8_t
```

The fields of a [RichTextFormat](#struct-richtextformat) that can follow the control's own value, as [RichEditBoxControl::CharacterFormat::control_default](#struct-characterformat) lists them. Flags.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `None` | no field |
| `Foreground` | the text color |
| `Background` | the highlight (none) |
| `FontFamily` | the font family |
| `FontSize` | the font size |
| `All` | every one of them |

### DisabledFormattingShortcuts

```cpp
enum class DisabledFormattingShortcuts : std::uint8_t
```

The Ctrl+B/I/U shortcuts, with their context menu commands, to leave out. Flags.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `None` | every shortcut works (the default) |
| `Bold` | no Ctrl+B / Bold |
| `Italic` | no Ctrl+I / Italic |
| `Underline` | no Ctrl+U / Underline |
| `All` | none of them |
